reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

source_record.population: Inherited 3700 frontier directions, with 82 A005 corrections. Eight additional A005 historical corrections are outside the frontier and resolved directly.
source_record.transport_limit: This helper transports authored factors, owner meanings, explicit exceptions and per-direction incidence. Valid references and role intersections are not independent evidence that a scientific argument is correct; independent fidelity and adversarial review remain required.

members.evidence_class: CONDITIONAL_NATIVE_ANALYTICAL_DERIVATION; reasoned examples, no field execution, no new measured effect
members.member_inference: EL-001 identifies whose outcome matters, the horizon and constraints that cannot be exchanged for throughput. These are criteria for whether a proposed slice is coherent and admissible, an explicit EA-04 native dependency. The batch comparison can exclude a fragment that has no usable outcome alone, or cannot meet a required constraint, before comparing setup, qualification, learning and reversal. The chosen batch can remain unchanged when the existing criterion was already adequate.
